changes: Fix MSAA resolving to a single-sampled image for offscreen rendering
Migrated baked Escape key to cancel maneuver to Cancel action, with a default for Escape. This allows it be assigned.
Minor cleanup of popup window code.
Minor cleanup of MSAA setting handling in GameSettings.
Delete old shader we don't need anymore

Added a generic token system for use in popups, this allows us to customize text in an HTML like way to have colored text, and references to key assignments. Implemented support for separators, new lines, color text, and references to input assignments.

Added WelcomePopup. Includes some basic instructions, and a 'always show' toggle along with an 'okay' button. This will help those who have the early external build to navigate the game until documentation is deployed. This is a generic system that can be used for other purposes.
Added a generic button system for popups to make it a lot easier to generate them, especially for modders.
Minor changes to Popup generic methods.
